strengths.point: Net profit is growing fast year on year.
Operating margin has widened over the last few years.
Interest cost is trivial next to operating profit.

strengths.point: Profit has compounded at a decent five-year clip.

weaknesses.point: Inventory tie up a lot of cash.

The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 5.32% over past five years.

weaknesses.point: Working capital intensity is on the higher side.

Earnings follow a seasonal cycle rather than a steady line.
weaknesses.evidence: CYCLICAL - strong: Mar, Jun; weak: Sep, Dec

weaknesses.point: Profit slipped versus the previous quarter.

opportunities.point: Buying below the model's intrinsic value leaves room for a re-rating.

opportunities.point: Uniparts expects FY27 top line growth to be a couple of percentage points higher than the growth achieved in FY26.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "our FY27 growth will be a couple of percentage points bigger than the growth that we had in FY26 on a year-on-year basis." (concall transcript - 2026-08-01)

opportunities.point: Management expects Q2 FY27 performance to be in line with Q1 FY27.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "So Q2 looks very robust, and I think Q2 should be in line with Q1." (concall transcript - 2026-08-01)

opportunities.point: Uniparts incurred capital expenditure of INR 12 crores during Q1 FY27 for capacity enhancement, productivity improvements, and customer initiatives.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "Capital expenditure during the quarter was INR12 crores, in line with ongoing investment plans focused on capacity enhancement, productivity improvement and customer-led growth initiatives." (concall transcript - 2026-08-01)

opportunities.point: Restoration of the finishing shop at the Ludhiana facility is progressing on schedule without customer supply disruption.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "On that note, the restoration of the finishing shop at our Ludhiana facility is progressing well and on schedule." (concall transcript - 2026-08-01)

opportunities.point: The price embeds less growth than the company has actually delivered.
opportunities.evidence: Reverse DCF implies 5.54% earnings growth vs 12% delivered over 5 years

opportunities.point: P/B is cheaper than the sector median.
Rising institutional interest can keep supporting the price.
opportunities.evidence: POSITIVE MONEY FLOW - institutional holding change 0.2 pp

opportunities.point: A automobile & auto components tailwind can lift earnings without the company doing anything different.
Construction equipment momentum started in H2 CY2025 has continued into Q1 FY27, driven by infrastructure investments in the U.S. and Europe.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "On the construction equipment, the momentum that started in the second half of calendar year 2025 has continued into Q1 of FY27." (concall transcript - 2026-08-01)

opportunities.point: Large agricultural equipment market conditions remain subdued, with CY2026 expected to mark the cyclical bottom ahead of a CY2027 recovery.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "Coming to the large agricultural equipment, conditions remain subdued as has been widely acknowledged across the industry." (concall transcript - 2026-08-01)

opportunities.point: Uniparts holds a trailing 12-month new business order book exceeding INR 225 crores across its three product platforms.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "On the business development front, our trailing 12-month new business order book remains robust at over INR225 crores with a healthy pipeline." (concall transcript - 2026-08-01)

threats.point: Profit is growing while operating cash flow is shrinking - an earnings-quality gap.
threats.evidence: Net profit 158 -> 196 Cr (TTM) but operating cash flow 182 Cr (Mar 2025) -> 174 Cr (Mar 2026)

threats.point: The stock has a history of very deep drawdowns.
A price that has outrun earnings needs the growth to catch up or it de-rates.
The ongoing West Asia situation continues to exert pressure on input costs and supply chain logistics.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "The ongoing West Asia situation has continued to exert pressure on input costs and supply chains." (concall transcript - 2026-08-01)

threats.point: Tariff-driven price volatility caused customers and channel partners to moderate discretionary purchasing in the aftermarket segment.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "The tariff-driven price volatility has led to some demand skewing, as higher prices caused customers and channel partners to moderate their purchasing." (concall transcript - 2026-08-01)

threats.point: Historically weak quarters (Sep, Dec) are still in the cycle.

swot.verdict: Strengths dominate the evidence (S31/W21/O29/T13), led by 'Capital efficiency is high - the business earns well above a normal cost of capital', with 63 points of weight still sitting on the weakness, opportunity and threat side.
